meta.description: US Financial Risk Dashboard - Daily Risk Scores

dimensions.fed_policy: 美联储政策风险 (0=宽松/降息, 100=极度收紧/加息)
dimensions.asset_valuation: 资产估值泡沫风险 (0=低估, 100=严重泡沫)
dimensions.credit_debt: 信用/主权债务风险 (0=健康, 100=危机)
dimensions.liquidity: 市场流动性风险 (0=充裕, 100=枯竭)
dimensions.systemic: 系统性金融风险 (0=稳定, 100=崩溃)
dimensions.geopolitical: 地缘政治金融冲击 (0=无威胁, 100=极端冲击)

meta.composite_formula: weighted average: fed_policy*0.25 + asset_valuation*0.20 + credit_debt*0.20 + liquidity*0.20 + systemic*0.10 + geopolitical*0.05

alert_levels.green: 0-39: 低风险 — 正常市场环境
alert_levels.yellow: 40-59: 中等风险 — 需要关注
alert_levels.red: 75-89: 极高风险 — 危机前兆
